free_tier.stated: 1 TB of free storage per user, announced 2026-06-26, 'made possible through a National Science Foundation Campus Cyberinfrastructure grant' and backed by the Open Storage Network. Additional storage $200/TB one-time. 550 files max per record.

egress.terms: Unmetered — no egress terms; Content-Security-Policy references caltech2.osn.mghpcc.org, i.e. storage sits on the Open Storage Network, an NSF-funded academic fabric

tooling: InvenioRDM REST API (/api/records, files under /api/records/<id>/files/<key>/content); purpose-built client caltechlibrary/caltechdata_api (github.com/caltechlibrary/caltechdata_api, 13 stars); the whole instance's source is public at caltechlibrary/caltechdata (11 stars) so the quota config is auditable
chaining: Records themselves are not account-capped, so 1 TB is a floor rather than a ceiling. Institutional deployments like this are exactly the 'more generous than Zenodo' pattern the brief predicted.
limits_note: 550 files per record; deposit requires a Caltech (access.caltech) identity, which is the real gate — the API reads are fully anonymous but writes are not open to the public.
